Nonblocking TCP client that sends an echo request and parses the shred version from the response.

# Purpose
This C file implements the client side of an IP echo protocol used to contact up to 16 servers and read a response that contains a shred version value. It defines the object lifecycle functions [`fd_ipecho_client_align`](<#fd_ipecho_client_align>), [`fd_ipecho_client_footprint`](<#fd_ipecho_client_footprint>), [`fd_ipecho_client_new`](<#fd_ipecho_client_new>), and [`fd_ipecho_client_join`](<#fd_ipecho_client_join>) for use with caller-managed shared memory. The [`fd_ipecho_client_init`](<#fd_ipecho_client_init>) function opens nonblocking TCP sockets, starts connections to the configured servers, and stores each socket in the client state together with per-peer send and receive state.

The file also contains the polling and response handling logic. [`fd_ipecho_client_poll`](<#fd_ipecho_client_poll>) drives the connection state machine with `poll`, sends a fixed request in [`write_conn`](<#write_conn>), reads the reply in [`read_conn`](<#read_conn>), and uses [`fd_ipecho_client_parse_response`](<#fd_ipecho_client_parse_response>) to validate the returned message format and extract the shred version. Helper functions [`close_one`](<#close_one>) and [`close_all`](<#close_all>) manage socket shutdown and peer count updates, and [`fd_ipecho_client_get_pollfds`](<#fd_ipecho_client_get_pollfds>) exposes the internal `pollfd` array for external polling use.
